name: archebase-vi-guide
description: Use whenever a request involves ArcheBase / 智域基石 brand work: VI review, logo selection, brand colors or typography, PPTX/decks/BPs, web/product UI, social or press graphics, video/event screens, image sourcing or generation, or brand templates. Routes work through the official VI Guide evidence, approved V2 assets, channel playbooks, deterministic validators and human release gates. For PPTX/POTX, use together with the shared pptx skill.
